reasons: contracted nuclear , 52.4% of the 6,448 MW nuclear fleet contracted to AWS (1,200 MW) and Meta (2,176 MW) on an operating basis, 59.1% including uprates (pxsresearch, October 2026), plus PJM capacity clearing at the $325-333/MW-day cap.

PJM capacity at the $325/MW-day cap on ~10,924 MW (≈$1.30B/year capacity revenue, pxsresearch) is genuine contracted pricing power , but it is capped upside (the cap limits further gains) and runs only through May 2029. Against it: Q2 2026 adjusted EPS $1.68 missed the $2.05 consensus, and management guided 2027 adjusted EBITDA toward the low end of $7.4-7.8B (August 7, 2026 call via TIKR).

The weakest element is merchant energy price-taking , ERCOT prices averaged ~$30/MWh in 2026, flat with 2025 (CEO Jim Burke, August 7, 2026 call via TIKR), ERCOT North Hub forwards fell 21% for 2027 between Q3 2025 and Q2 2026 reporting dates, and batteries now shave the evening peaks that used to set generator margins (Brandon Leon analysis, October 2026 , single-source analysis, flagged). Per the task instruction, VST is not premiumed as if it were a regulated utility: its earnings are merchan

reasons: Digital funnel economics are filed, not asserted: 196,220 policies activated in H1 2026 (Q2 +133% YoY) at a 33% contribution margin (Q2 2026 release), with the Direct channel growing 131% at similar unit economics to the existing book.

The in-force book is a contracted cash asset: commissions receivable of $324.280M at 2026-06-30 (10-Q) represents future renewal commissions on policies already sold, which gives forward cash flow a contracted base most growth-stage distributors do not have.

No premium is awarded: Ethos owns distribution, not the customer relationship or the risk. Carrier concentration is severe (Carrier A 41% and Carrier B 38% of H1 2026 revenue, 10-Q), carriers can reprice or insource distribution, and third-party agent persistency already requires active termination discipline per the filing. Cross-check held at 0% (neutral); concentration carried as a risk ranking and a Bear-case driver, never netted into the target.
